name: dns-filter
description: DNS forwarding filter: UDP/TCP listener, client range check, domain rules (allow > API > config > known DoH) answered with NXDOMAIN, single upstream relay with response validation, in-memory query log, rule API, and hand-off of resolved addresses to network-watch.
cardTemplate: Summarise the dns-filter domain: per-site env listen/upstream, client policy, rule precedence and storage, NXDOMAIN answers, upstream validation, query log retention (memory only), and the /api/v1/dns-filter API.
rationale: The DNS filter owns a network listener and a name-based policy that change independently of packet capture (network-watch) and firewall blocking. It only hands resolved addresses to network-watch. Tests also belong to the cross-cutting test-environment domain.
